# Themes

<!-- Generated from the engine code by `make docs`: do not edit by hand. -->

Themes are consumables (planets, in the original): bought in the shop for $3,
they wait in the clipboard (2 slots) until applied, at any time; each one
levels up a poker hand type (see [hands.md](hands.md)). The themes of the
secret hands only show up once the hand was played.

| Id | Theme | Effect | Quip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `matte_black` | Matte Black | Levels up High Card | *Nothing matches. Nothing needs to.* |
| `rose_pine` | Rosé Pine | Levels up Pair | *A glass for you, a glass for me.* |
| `ristretto` | Ristretto | Levels up Two Pair | *Two shots, twice.* |
| `osaka_jade` | Osaka Jade | Levels up Three of a Kind | *Three stones, all jade.* |
| `nord` | Nord | Levels up Straight | *Due north, in a straight line.* |
| `everforest` | Everforest | Levels up Flush | *Green as far as you can see.* |
| `kanagawa` | Kanagawa | Levels up Full House | *The great wave fills the house.* |
| `catppuccin` | Catppuccin | Levels up Four of a Kind | *Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, Mocha.* |
| `tokyo_night` | Tokyo Night | Levels up Straight Flush | *Neon, in perfect sequence.* |
| `hackerman` | Hackerman | Levels up Five of a Kind | *I'm in. Five times.* |
| `ethereal` | Ethereal | Levels up Majestic Monolith | *Above the clouds. No cloud bill.* |
| `flexoki_light` | Flexoki Light | Levels up Fork Bomb | *Blinding. Exponentially.* |
